name: Lyssia Valencia
source: Lyssia is Michael's friend who has known Michael since high school. She is known as a person who wants everything done quickly. It is known that in high school, Lyssia was a delinquent woman. She often skipped along with Michael. However, the scores ​​in the class are maintained and she even always in the top rank.
